Usage: mcpjam cloud projects servers create|add [options]

Create a saved MCP server

Options:
  --project <id-or-name>  Project name or ID
  --body <json>           Server JSON body
  -h, --help              display help for command

8:- [MCPJam in Claude](https://docs.mcpjam.com/hosted/claude-connector.md): Connect Claude to your MCPJam account through the hosted MCP server — projects, saved servers, evals, and user testing
11:- [GitHub Checks](https://docs.mcpjam.com/github-checks.md): Run an eval suite against the MCP server built from every pull request, and read the result as a check run, a pull-request comment, and a machine-readable JSON block.
24:- [Evaluate](https://docs.mcpjam.com/inspector/evals.md): Author test cases for your MCP server, run them across models, and gate pass/fail on deterministic assertions plus optional LLM-as-judge.
39:- [CLI Overview](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/overview.md): Local MCP testing and mcpjam cloud: probing, debugging, OAuth, conformance, and hosted evals from your terminal
41:- [Local Evals](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/local-evals.md): Run an MCPJam eval suite file on your machine with mcpjam test with local results and an MCPJam identity
52:- [CI / CD](https://docs.mcpjam.com/cli/ci.md): Run MCP health checks, conformance suites, and evals in GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, and other CI environments
56:- [@mcpjam/sdk](https://docs.mcpjam.com/sdk/index.md): MCP server unit testing, end-to-end (e2e) testing, and server evals
62:- [Running Evals](https://docs.mcpjam.com/sdk/concepts/running-evals.md): Measure tool accuracy with statistical evaluations
63:- [Reliable evals in CI](https://docs.mcpjam.com/sdk/concepts/enterprise-evals.md): Bound execution, preserve evidence, and distinguish an eval verdict from successful reporting.
71:- [EvalSuite](https://docs.mcpjam.com/sdk/reference/eval-suite.md): API reference for EvalSuite
73:- [runSuiteFile](https://docs.mcpjam.com/sdk/reference/run-suite-file.md): API reference for running an MCPJam suite file locally from code
88:- [Create an eval run (async)](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/create-an-eval-run-async.md): Creates a suite run from an existing `suiteId` (rerun) and/or inline `tests`, then **detaches execution and responds `202` immediately** with the `runId`. Validation and quota errors surface on this request; poll `GET /eval-runs/{runId}` for progress. The run appears live in the hosted UI Runs tab,…
98:- [List a suite's runs](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/list-a-suites-runs.md): Recent runs for a suite, newest first.
99:- [List a suite's per-run stage analytics](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/list-a-suites-per-run-stage-analytics.md): One materialized stage-analytics document per RUN, newest completion first: where trials fell out of the six-stage user-value chain (connection, discovery, selection, tool call, response, user value), overall and sliced marginally by intent, model and host.
101:- [Get one run's suite quality-gate report](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-one-runs-suite-quality-gate-report.md): ONE run's stored suite quality-gate report (`SuiteGateReportV1`): passed, failed, non_gateable, or not_configured.
102:- [Enable, repoint, or disable a suite's schedule](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/enable-repoint-or-disable-a-suites-schedule.md): A schedule fires exactly ONE run per interval, so an environment-based suite must pin exactly one of its attached environments. Omitting `environmentId` on a single-environment suite means that environment; omitting it on a multi-environment suite is a VALIDATION_ERROR. Disabling preserves the exist…
104:- [Create an eval suite (author-only, does not run)](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/create-an-eval-suite-author-only-does-not-run.md): Creates a runnable eval suite — the suite record plus its test cases — and responds `201` **synchronously**, WITHOUT executing anything. Use this to author a suite, then run it later with `POST /eval-runs` (passing the returned `suiteId`).
105:- [Resolve or create a file-owned eval suite](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/resolve-or-create-a-file-owned-eval-suite.md): Resolve a file-owned suite by declared id within the project, or create one. Lookup is by `(projectId, declaredSuiteId)` and never by name. A UI-authored suite has no declared id and cannot be claimed. The inspector parses the suite file; this body is the declared identity, source hash, optional pro…
106:- [Get one eval suite's configuration](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-one-eval-suites-configuration.md): The suite's full settings — attached environments, hosts, execution config, judge, schedule. The list route returns run rollups instead; this is the shape the edit routes read and write.
107:- [Delete an eval suite](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/delete-an-eval-suite.md): Deletes the suite and its cases. Past runs are not deleted.
108:- [Update an eval suite's settings](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/update-an-eval-suites-settings.md): Partial update — omitted fields are left as they are. `environmentIds` is tri-state: a non-empty array sets/replaces, `null` clears (reverting the suite to legacy config), and `[]` is rejected rather than silently treated as a clear. Responds with the full updated suite.
109:- [Get the pre-run disclosure for a suite launch plan](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/get-the-pre-run-disclosure-for-a-suite-launch-plan.md): What happens to a run's content BEFORE you launch it: which models it calls and where they route, which LLM analyzers/judges can fire and where their evidence goes, capture/retention/region facts, and the subprocessors engaged. Read-only — never launches or gates a run. Keyed by the SAME destination…
110:- [List a suite's eval cases](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/list-a-suites-eval-cases.md): Every case in the suite, in the public steps-first shape.
111:- [Create an eval case](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/create-an-eval-case.md): Adds one case to the suite. Both `title` and a non-empty `steps` array are required — `steps` is optional on the shared case shape so PATCH can be partial, but a case persisted without executable steps could never run. When `models` is omitted the suite's configured model is used.
112:- [Create several eval cases](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/create-several-eval-cases.md): Adds up to 100 cases to the suite in one call — the bulk form of the single create, and the way to import a suite or convert a repo's test files without a round trip per case.
